create_Opt_instance: create an Opt instance to hold Minecraft world configuration parameters like SL, H, and GROUND_DEPTH
configure_mob_count: set the mob_config attribute on an Opt instance to control the number of mobs in the world
configure_gettable_items: set the gettable_items list on an Opt instance to define which items are available in the world
adjust_world_dimensions: modify the SL and H attributes on an Opt instance to change the world size and height
review_Opt_class: review the Opt class and its default configuration values for Minecraft world generation parameters
